notes.title: Join the Giveaway Madness: Free Pointy Ends Keys on our Official Livestream!
notes.notes:
[h1]Stream Details[/h1]
Missed the previous stream? Not to worry! We will be rehosting the stream today and will be giving away keys again! 

Experience the thrill of Pointy Ends like never before! Join us for an action-packed livestream where we'll provide an exciting gameplay overview of our highly anticipated game. Witness the captivating visuals, immerse yourself in the over the top knight brawling VR gameplay, and get a taste of the epic battles that await.

But that's not all—we have a surprise for you! Throughout the livestream, we'll be dropping keys for the full game. Yes, you heard it right! You'll have a chance to secure your very own key and unlock the complete experience of Pointy Ends. Don't miss this exclusive and mega awesome opportunity.

Play our free demo [b]LIMITED TIME ONLY[/b] during Next Fest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552840/Pointy_Ends/]Store Page[/url]!

Mark your calendars and join us live to witness the epic gameplay overview, grab your chance to win game keys, and experience the free demo firsthand. This is your chance to be part of the action and unleash your Pointy Ended potential!

[h1]Socials[/h1]
Follow us on Twitter! ► https://twitter.com/PointyEndsVR

Follow us on Tiktok!► https://www.tiktok.com/@altereyes

Join our Discord! ►https://discord.gg/xh2ZrWncH7

[h1]About Pointy Ends[/h1]

Enter the biggest tournament of the realm where you’ll engage in ranged combat with your fellow knights using all kinds of medieval weaponry. Combine skill and strategy to fight each other in epic fast-paced battles. Entertain the crowd and earn eternal glory. Have courage, aim, dodge, and beware of the pointy ends!

[h2]Action-packed multiplayer[/h2]

Pointy Ends is an accessible fast-paced PVP battle with up to 4 players. Missing players? Not to worry, noble bots will fill in.

[h2]Medieval weaponry[/h2]

Battle with friends and foes using a variety of medieval weaponry like bow and arrow, crossbows, mace, slingshot or a battle axe.

[h2]Kingdoms Unite[/h2]

Play across different headsets and controllers (Vive, Oculus, Index). Pointy Ends unites the realm of virtual reality in one cross-platform kingdom.

[h2]Get involved[/h2]

Pointy Ends is released in early access which means your experience and feedback will give us the opportunity to bring the game to ever greater heights. Our current plan for the full release includes new weapons, modes, environments, and other features. But we want you to be involved, help us prioritize and let us know which direction you want Pointy Ends to go.
